pages.title: Practice Faster
pages.text: Skills, equipment, and class attributes can increase the proficiency XP earned from your actions. An overall modifier affects every tree, while a tree modifier affects just its own discipline. These bonuses change how quickly your proficiency bar fills.

pages.title: Combining Bonuses
pages.text: Overall and tree multipliers multiply together. With 20% extra overall XP and 50% extra Fire XP, 10 Fire XP becomes 18. An additional matching skill bonus of 25% makes that 22.5 XP. Fractional XP is retained.

pages.title: Separate Currencies
pages.text: Learning bonuses do not multiply direct skill-point grants or Minecraft experience. They do not change a skill's purchase price. A server operator's direct XP command gives its exact stated amount. Tree level limits and world-tier limits still apply.
